# Jai'fore

> Jai'fore (Jai'fore Media, United States) sells custom printed apparel and merchandise, graphic design, and web development. Customers can design their own pieces in an online Design Studio or shop ready-made items. Prices are in US dollars, paid by card through Stripe, and we ship worldwide.

## Key facts
- Free shipping on physical orders of $60 or more; flat $15 below that. Web development is by enquiry.
- Custom orders take 5-14 business days to produce and ship.
- Orders can be cancelled within 2 hours of placement if production has not started.
- Contact: jaifore@outlook.com (replies within 2 business days).
